job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI models using AWS services such as SageMaker, Comprehend, and Rekognition.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems and applications.
Develop data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze large datasets for training machine learning models.
Troubleshoot issues related to AI model performance, scalability, and reliability.

Job Requirements :

6-9 years of experience in developing AI models using Python programming language.
Strong understanding of AWS services including SageMaker, Comprehend, Rekognition SDKs.
Experience with data pipeline development using Python libraries like Pandas, NumPy etc.
